summary: One notification per event — in-app card and OS banner no longer fire simultaneously
fixes: OS banner was firing at the same time as the in-app action card when app was in foreground — document.hasFocus() is unreliable on iOS PWA and was returning false even when app was fully visible
Replaced hasFocus() check with document.visibilityState==='visible' — OS banner now correctly suppressed whenever ClinBridge is on screen
Result: app in foreground = in-app card only. App backgrounded = OS banner only. Never both.
